title: Research CatalystX9 LabNotebookSOP

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Catalyst-X9 Laboratory Notebook to SOP conversion task. Deliverables include: (1) Python parsing code to extract structured data from narrative notebook text, (2) Visualization code generating 4 figures (process flow diagram, temperature profile, reagent volumes, timeline Gantt chart), (3) Parsed data in JSON format, (4) Complete synthesis_sop.md document with 7 procedural steps, 4 verification checkpoints, critical parameters with tolerances, and quality indicators optimized for night-shift bench use, (5) Comprehensive research report documenting methodology, results with figures, and discussion. The SOP transforms informal lab notes into a version-controlled, executable procedure suitable for shift handoffs.
